title: Deploy on Cloudflare Workers
prompt: Deploy the app on Cloudflare Workers. Add src/worker.ts as the Worker entry point that serves the whole app (routes, health, OpenAPI and MCP), and a wrangler.jsonc in the project root for a Worker named "notes-api" whose main is src/worker.ts, set up so that Worker vars and secrets reach the app's config() settings. Do not change src/server.ts.
